usage: Celery is a common type of vegetable.
It is well suited for stir-frying or making salads.
When buying celery, choose stalks with tender leaves and no yellowing.
Celery has a crisp texture and can be eaten raw or cooked.
Celery is rich in fibre and is good for your health.
